articles.body:
Famosos e artistas comemoraram a reeleição de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Ao derrotar Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), o petista se tornou o primeiro presidente do Brasil eleito quatro vezes pelo voto popular.

articles.title: In 2022, Mark Wahlberg bought Las Vegas land for $15.6 million, then sold it for $17.25 million in 2024 without building his dream home
articles.summary: Mark Wahlberg sells a 2.5-acre plot in Las Vegas for $17.25 million in 2024 after purchasing it for $15.6 million in 2022 without developing his planned luxury residence.
articles.body: Mark Wahlberg sold a 2.5-acre Las Vegas plot for $17.25 million in December 2024, reportedly a $1.65 million gross gain. He purchased the undeveloped land for $15.6 million in 2022, intending to build a luxury family residence. However, the mansion never materialised, and the property changed hands while still vacant.According to the Las Vegas Review-Journal, the transaction was documented in Clark County property records. The deal marked a change in Wahlberg’s plans for a Nevada home after he moved his family from California to Las Vegas.Mark Wahlberg bought 2.5 acres in Las Vegas in 2022In July 2022, Wahlberg purchased two adjoining parcels in The Summit Club, an exclusive residential community in Summerlin, west of Las Vegas. The land, previously owned by former professional motorcycle racer Ben Bostrom, covered approximately 2.5 acres and cost $15.6 million.The community is known for its luxury homes, golf facilities, recreational amenities and private surroundings. The purchase suggested that Wahlberg was preparing to establish a substantial family residence in Nevada, where he had also explored opportunities connected to the entertainment industry.Inside the $25 million mansion plan that never took shapeWahlberg’s original vision went beyond owning vacant land. Plans submitted for the property proposed a custom-built residence measuring approximately 37,694 square feet, with a reported construction contract valuation of $25 million.The proposed mansion would have offered extensive living space and privacy within the upscale community. However, the project did not progress to construction.In October 2024, Wahlberg requested additional time for the plan-review process. The request stated that he needed to “finalise and secure construction financing.” No building permits had been issued for the proposed residence, according to the newspaper’s review of county records.Instead of moving ahead with the ambitious project, Wahlberg decided to sell the land before the end of 2024. The planned home therefore remained on paper, leaving the buyer with an undeveloped site.The Las Vegas land sold for $17.25 million in 2024The sale was completed on December 31, 2024, for $17.25 million. The purchasing entity was identified as Summit PS LLC, although the available reporting did not establish its ultimate owner.Wahlberg’s name was not listed directly on the deed. The transaction was to the trust associated with his original purchase, identifying him as its trustee.Comparing the two sale prices, the land’s value increased by $1.65 million between the 2022 purchase and the 2024 sale. That’s just the gross difference between the two deals, not necessarily Wahlberg’s final profit. Taxes, closing costs and other expenses could cut into what he actually held on to.Mark Wahlberg’s journey from rapper to Hollywood starMark Wahlberg is an American actor and producer who first gained attention as a rapper under the name Marky Mark before establishing himself in Hollywood. His breakthrough film role came in ‘Boogie Nights’ (1997), followed by performances in ‘The Departed’, ‘The Fighter’, ‘Ted’ and ‘Transformers: Age of Extinction’. He received an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor for ‘The Departed’ and has also earned recognition for his work as a producer on television projects including ‘Entourage’ and ‘Boardwalk Empire’. Wahlberg is married to model Rhea Durham.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: James Gunn Defends the DC Universe, Says He Dislikes the Idea That ‘Individual Stories Aren’t Meaningful Unless They Lead to Something’
articles.summary: James Gunn took to Threads on Saturday to defend the DCU and his decision to expand the universe with “individual stories” amid criticism that his films aren...
articles.body:
James Gunn took to Threads on Saturday to defend the DCU and his decision to expand the universe with "individual stories" amid criticism that his films aren't building toward a major crossover event.

Responding to a commenter who pointed out that Gunn doesn't necessarily need to lay the foundation for one totally interconnected universe, the DC Studios co-head wrote, "I couldn't agree more." "DCU is just an alternate universe; we can enter at any location or time and tell THAT story. I dislike the idea that individual stories aren't meaningful unless they lead to something else. People not understanding this is strange to me, because 'Star Wars' has essentially been doing this for 50 years across movies, shows, games and books, admittedly without the tonal variety," he wrote.

Gunn pointed out that this approach doesn't mean there isn't any connectivity, adding that the "Superman" saga begins with "Superman" and extends into "Man of Tomorrow," "and contains many characters we've introduced in other stories." "But that doesn't mean those other stories only exist to set up what's happening there. I would love people to be seeing 'Clayface' because it's a great, fun horror movie unto itself, not because of where else Clayface will show up three movies from now," he concluded.

In the post that Gunn responded to, the user had replied to an image that listed out his DC Universe foundation — "Superman," "Peacemaker," "Supergirl," "Creature Commandos," "Clayface" and "Lanters" — followed by the text: "What is this building towards???"

"Clayface," which his theaters on Friday, is Gunn's latest DCU installment, following 2025's "Superman" and this year's "Supergirl." (Ahead of the film's release, comic fans pointed out that the character, who has never been the subject of a standalone feature film, is a considerably nicher choice than previous DCU films.) It generated $24 million from 3,458 North American theaters in its debut, comfortably taking the No. 1 spot at the box office.

Directed by James Watkins, "Clayface" follows the titular Batman villain, a rising movie star also known as Matt Hagen (Tom Rhys Harries), who volunteers for a highly experimental medical procedure after his face is severely disfigured. Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan also star.

Variety's Guy Lodge called the film "its own ugly animal; perhaps the characters and conflicts introduced here would pall if given the franchise treatment, but in the context of a single, genre-melding romp, they're fresh and ickily enjoyable."

Gunn's next film, " Superman: Man of Tomorrow ," hits theaters July 9, 2027.

articles.title: Trump compliments Nicki Minaj's 'beautiful' butt in rally speech
articles.summary: President Donald Trump returned the favor for his "No. 1" fan, Nicki Minaj, by calling out her "hard to miss" backside at a Republican rally.
articles.body:
After a year of " No. 1 fan " Nicki Minaj heaping praise on President Donald Trump , the president is returning the favor with compliments of his own.

Minaj, 43, traveled with Trump on Air Force One Sunday, Oct. 25, to attend a rally in the border city of Port Huron, Michigan, as Republicans fight analysts' projections of a blue wave during the midterm elections. The two lent their star power to former U.S. Rep. Mike Rogers , who is facing off against Democrat Abdul El-Sayed , and Rep. John James , who is vying against Democratic Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson for Gov. Gretchen Whitmer 's seat.

During his nearly two-hour appearance, Trump alleged that reporting on his previous remarks about appreciating Sen. Jon Husted's butt , which were said "in fun," lacked context of the Republican Ohio senator's football background.

"I've never done that with a man before. Off the record, women? Yes. Men? No," Trump said. "By the way, I looked at one hell of a beautiful a-- before: Nicki Minaj."

"That's hard to miss," he said of the "Pink Friday" artist, before saying, "Stand up! That's hard to miss."

After Minaj rose from her seat and waved to the crowd, Trump continued, "I hope Nicki wasn't insulted, but we love Nicki. She's been with us for a long time."

Later in the evening, after Minaj stumped for the Republicans in a two-minute speech, Trump commended the "Starships" rapper by saying, "She never looked more beautiful" and "She is a very special person. She gets it, smart."

Trump, Nicki Minaj hold hands at DC summit

Nicki Minaj has become one of Hollywood's most outspoken Trump supporters, even calling herself his "No. 1 fan." See the rapper and singer-songwriter hold hands with President Donald Trump on stage during the U.S. Treasury Department's Trump Accounts Summit in Washington, D.C., on Jan. 28, 2026.

Trump's comments come three months after he made a joke about Minaj "twerking" at the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Association Dinner as attendees "yelled, 'Get down!'" when a gunman allegedly opened fire outside the room during the originally scheduled event on April 25.

Nicki Minaj to Trump: I'll vote for you 'if you run again'

Minaj, who was previously critical of Trump's immigration policies during his first term, has closely aligned with him and the Republican Party in his second term. She has appeared with him at events such as the U.S. Treasury Department's "Trump Accounts" summit and a White House Rose Garden luncheon.

As Trump introduced the "queen of rap," he joked, "You know, I don't like being overshadowed, and this woman overshadows me, and I'm angry about it. They're going crazy over her."

After reaching the podium, Minaj started her speech by leading the crowd in chanting, "We love Trump."

She encouraged Michiganders to "be a leader in this movement that's happening right now" during "a major turning point for our country," then shared her negative views against gender-affirming care for transgender children.

"We want our children to grow up in a place where we can be proud of. We don't want our children to be bombarded with sex changes, right?" she said. "We want people to leave the children alone, leave them out of it."

To wrap up her short speech, Minaj addressed Trump: " President Trump , it is an honor to stand with you every single time, and I will continue to support you forever and ever. If you run again, I will support you again."

articles.title: Sunny Deol's 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak' song brings Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu together after 21 Years; 'Suniyo Zara' teaser arrives October 26
articles.summary: Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu have reunited for a musical collaboration after 21 years.
articles.body: Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu have reunited for a musical collaboration after 21 years. The veteran playback singers have recorded 'Suniyo Zara', the first song from Sunny Deol's upcoming movie 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak'. Their last joint appearance was in 'Kahaan Ho Tum' from the 2005 movie 'No Entry'.According to Variety, the new track features their voices for Sunny Deol, Ravi Kishan and other cast members. Anupam Amod has also joined the collaboration. RAAHEE, associated with Pritam's JAM8, composed the music, while Priya Saraiya penned the lyrics. The song is expected to celebrate friendship and togetherness.Reportedly, the number unfolds like a “journey song.” The report describes it as “A vibrant, emotional track,” expected to “capture the spirit of timeless melodies that will resonate with today’s listeners.”The teaser is scheduled to release on October 26, followed by the full song on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. The collaboration also marks Udit Narayan and Kumar Sanu's first association with Sunny Deol in 24 years. Their previous playback work for the actor was in the 2002 movie 'Karz - The Burden Of Truth', which also starred Suneil Shetty and Shilpa Shetty.IMA raises objections to film's medical portrayalIn other news, Sunny Deol's upcoming movie has drawn criticism from the Indian Medical Association (IMA) over its promotional content. The organisation wrote to Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, raising concerns about how the medical profession is represented.In its letter dated October 22, 2026, the IMA objected to what it viewed as a generalisation of corruption in healthcare. It also questioned the depiction of violence against medical professionals, warning that such portrayals could affect public trust and the safety of healthcare workers.Medical body highlights public trust concernsAccording to ANI, the IMA cautioned against presenting corruption as a widespread feature of the healthcare sector. It also raised concerns about how the portrayal of violence against doctors could influence public attitudes towards medical professionals.The letter stated, “We wish to express our serious concern regarding the portrayal of the medical profession in the film ‘SURYAA Ant Se Aarambh Tak’. Its promotional content raises concerns about the generalisation of corruption within healthcare, the depiction of violence against medical professionals, and the potential consequences for public trust and the safety of healthcare workers.”CBFC confirms movie has not been submittedThe Ministry of Information and Broadcasting clarified that the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) has not received 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak' for certification. The statement confirms that the certification process has not yet begun. 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak' also has Ravi Kishan and Pragya Jaiswal in important roles.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Aamir Khan was reportedly the first target before shooters switched to Tiger Shroff; police investigate alleged handlers
articles.summary: TRIGGER WARNING: This article contains gruesome details of violence, which could be triggering for some readers.
articles.body: TRIGGER WARNING: This article contains gruesome details of violence, which could be triggering for some readers.Police investigating the October 18 firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff are examining reports that the alleged attackers initially planned to target Aamir Khan. According to The Indian Express, citing police reports, the suspects changed their target after struggling to approach Aamir Khan. They allegedly chose Shroff because his movements made him easier to reach. Investigators are also probing the role of alleged handlers who reportedly supplied information during the suspects’ escape.Aamir Khan was allegedly the initial targetThe alleged shooters reportedly spent nearly a month in Mumbai monitoring Aamir Khan’s movements. According to the outlet, suspects visited the vicinity of his residence at least three times. However, Khan’s frequent travel for film shoots and extended periods at home allegedly made it difficult to approach him.The suspects subsequently shifted their attention to Tiger Shroff, who reportedly played football at a Juhu park on most Sundays. The firing took place at the same location on October 18. Police sources reportedly linked the alleged plan involving Khan to threats he received in July, attributed to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang.Shooters allegedly received updates through encrypted appsInvestigators suspect the three alleged shooters received real-time information about the police operation through handlers using encrypted Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) messaging applications. According to police reports cited by PTI, news reports about the attack and the investigation helped the suspects adjust their escape plans.When television channels broadcast footage showing the suspected attackers, one of them allegedly received an urgent warning. Police sources told the outlet that the message read, “Tumhare chehre aa gaye hain, nikal jao waha se" (Your faces are out, get out of there).The three accused, Phool Singh (18), Rehan Rahisuddin Ansari (18) and Rithik Mahto (22), were arrested by Kota Police in Rajasthan on October 19 while travelling by train. Investigators reportedly found that Rehan maintained regular contact through internet-based services such as Signal or Zangi.Suspects allegedly changed transport during escapeThe alleged handlers reportedly informed the suspects about the recovery of the motorcycle used in the attack in Andheri. They also passed on information about developments surrounding their train journey, according to police reports cited by PTI.The three men allegedly switched between different modes of transport while attempting to evade arrest. They travelled by motorcycle and train, took a cab and planned to board a bus from Surat. A delay at the bus terminal reportedly forced them to take another train. Kota Police eventually apprehended them after receiving an alert from Mumbai Police.Firearms recovered as investigation expandsThe shooting occurred in Mumbai’s Juhu neighbourhood on October 18. Police said at least two men fired multiple rounds at Tiger Shroff’s car before escaping on a motorcycle. Five to six rounds were reportedly fired. Shroff escaped relatively unharmed, while his driver and a bystander sustained injuries. The motorcycle allegedly used in the incident was later recovered in Andheri.Investigators subsequently recovered two firearms and 10 live cartridges in Surat, officials told the outlet. The weapons were sent for forensic examination and ballistic testing to determine whether they matched the empty cartridges recovered at the scene.Eleven people held as police probe alleged conspiracyThe Mumbai Crime Branch and local police also apprehended 22-year-old Pranjal Thakran in Indore. Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police Rajesh Dandotia said that Thakran, originally from Sonipat in Haryana, had travelled to Indore five days earlier for his paralysed brother’s treatment.Police suspect he provided financial, logistical or operational assistance to the alleged shooters and other conspirators. His apprehension brought the total number of people held in the case to 11, with arrests reported across Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Haryana.Mumbai Police have reportedly named gangster Anil Pandit as a wanted accused. According to the report, Pandit, an alleged associate of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang believed to be operating from the United States, claimed responsibility for the firing in a social media post.A case has been registered under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Arms Act. The Crime Branch is continuing its investigation into the alleged conspiracy, the procurement of firearms and the identities of those suspected of providing weapons and logistical support. articles.title: Lalit Prabhakar reveals how watching a single YouTube video and studying two photographs helped him transform into Ajmal Kasab for Rajkummar Rao’s ‘Prahaar’: ‘The main task was perfecting the dialect and tone’
articles.summary: Lalit Prabhakar has opened up about preparing to play 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks convict Ajmal Kasab in ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam’,
articles.body: Lalit Prabhakar has opened up about preparing to play 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks convict Ajmal Kasab in ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam’, headlined by Rajkummar Rao. The actor revealed that conversations with director Avinash Arun, studying publicly available photographs and watching a single YouTube video of Kasab helped shape his performance. He also explained why understanding the character’s psychology and getting the dialect and tone right were crucial to bringing the role to the screen.Lalit Prabhakar on how Avinash Arun’s vision shaped his portrayal of Ajmal KasabPrabhakar knew the role offered him an opportunity to explore unfamiliar territory when he was asked to audition for Kasab. According to the actor, it took just two takes for Arun to feel that he had found the right person for the part. However, preparing for the character required considerably more work.Explaining the director’s approach, Prabhakar said to Mid Day, “I spent time with Avinash sir as he expressed his approach towards the character, how he wanted to humanise it, and didn’t want to [adopt] the melodramatic, filmy style. He believed Kasab’s psyche should be our focus. What exactly does it mean to be brainwashed? If a person has killed so many people and is ready to die, how would his eyes and expressions be?”The actor’s preparation centred on understanding the psychology behind the character rather than relying on dramatic mannerisms. Arun wanted the portrayal to focus on Kasab’s mindset, expressions and behaviour, allowing the performance to remain grounded rather than veering into a conventional, exaggerated depiction.Lalit Prabhakar reveals how one YouTube video helped him prepare for ‘Prahaar’Prabhakar also researched the case by reading 26/11 Kasab Ani Me, a book by Ramesh Mahale, the chief investigating officer of the Mumbai terror attacks. He supplemented his reading with the limited visual material of Kasab available publicly.“There’s only one video of Kasab available on YouTube. That’s all I could watch. I studied his two-three photos that are in public domain. The main task was [perfecting] the dialect and tone,” the actor said.The limited availability of footage meant that Prabhakar had to pay close attention to the material he could access. He focused particularly on reproducing Kasab’s speech patterns and tone, while also considering the character’s expressions and psychological state.About ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam’Directed by Avinash Arun, ‘Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam’ revisits the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks and the legal proceedings that followed, focusing on public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam’s role in the case against Kasab.Rajkummar Rao plays Nikam, while Prabhakar portrays Kasab. The film also features Wamiqa Gabbi, Jaideep Ahlawat, Sikandar Kher and Ashish Vidyarthi in key roles. The courtroom drama brings the prosecution and trial into focus, with the confrontation between Nikam and Kasab forming a central part of the narrative.With respect to the film's box office performance, by Day 10, the film's total domestic earnings to stood at Rs. 20.10 crore net and Rs. 23.93 crore gross. Internationally, its overall worldwide gross stood at Rs. 26.78 crore.Lalit Prabhakar’s upcoming projectsFollowing his appearance in ‘Prahaar’, Prabhakar has several projects in different stages of development. He is set to portray poet and Dalit Panther co-founder Namdeo Dhasal in the biopic ‘Dhasal’, with music by Ilaiyaraaja.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.summary: Directed by Aakash Kaushik and starring Ayushmann Khurrana alongside Sara Ali Khan, the action-spy comedy 'Udta Teer' maintains momentum on its first
articles.body: Directed by Aakash Kaushik and starring Ayushmann Khurrana alongside Sara Ali Khan, the action-spy comedy 'Udta Teer' maintains momentum on its first Monday. After a promising opening weekend performance across domestic and overseas circuits, the film now targets critical weekday stability to cement its theatrical run. Having comfortably crossed the Rs. 25 crore threshold in global gross earnings over its opening weekend, 'Udta Teer' now faces its first major weekday test on Day 4. The Rs 25 crore India net is the nearest target since the immediate goal for the theatrical venture is securing a firm Monday hold by keeping domestic net slip within a manageable range compared to its opening day.Sustaining consistent audience turnout during evening and night shows will position the film to hit the Rs. 30-crore domestic net mark before completing its first week. Additionally, steady performance in key overseas territories will be crucial as the project aims to cross the Rs. 35-crore worldwide gross milestone entering its second weekend.'Udta Teer' domestic box office runThe film opened with Rs 4.10 crore net across 6,265 shows on Day 1, with an India gross of Rs. 4.83 crore. Day 2 brought a jump of nearly 77% to Rs. 7.25 crore across 6,164 shows, taking the India net to Rs. 11.35 crore and the gross to Rs. 13.53 crore. Day 3 rose by about 13% to Rs. 8.20 crore across 6,020 shows. That brought the three-day India net to Rs. 19.55 crore and the India gross to Rs. 23.37 crore.‘Udta Teer’ overseas collection and worldwide totalOverseas, the film made Rs. 1.25 crore on Day 1, which put the worldwide gross at Rs. 6.08 crore. Day 2 added Rs. 1.50 crore, taking the overseas gross to Rs. 2.75 crore and the worldwide gross to Rs. 16.28 crore. Day 3 brought another Rs. 1.75 crore, lifting the overseas total to Rs. 4.50 crore. The story follows Bilal Ahmad (Ayushmann Khurrana), a Pakistani operative dispatched on an undercover assignment in India who loses his memory following an explosion. articles.title: Grammy-winning singer Chris Brown avoids prison time for brawling at a London nightclub
articles.summary: Grammy award winning singer Chris Brown is to be sentenced Monday over brawling at a London nightclub three years ago.
articles.body: LONDON — Grammy-winning singer Chris Brown avoided prison time Monday for beating a music producer with a tequila bottle at a London nightclub three years ago. The 37-year-old was given an eight-month sentence, suspended for a year. He had faced up to three years in prison after pleading guilty to a count of affray in July for the attack on the dance floor of Tape, a private club in the swanky Mayfair neighborhood in February 2023. Video footage played in court showed Brown having to be pulled away from the victim, his former friend Abraham Diaw, after striking him twice in the head with a bottle. “The repeated use of a glass bottle in that way, especially aimed at the head, was plainly dangerous, it carried the risk of delivering a more serious injury than was ultimately sustained,” Judge Tony Baumgartner said in Southwark Crown Court. Despite the seriousness of the attack, Baumgartner said Brown did not qualify for a custodial sentence because he pleaded guilty and there were several mitigating circumstances, including stable employment and charity work. The judge acknowledged Brown’s previous convictions but said he had maintained a clean record in recent years. Previous brushes with the law Brown has faced repeated legal trouble since his felony conviction in the 2009 assault of his then-girlfriend, Rihanna, hours before the pair were due to perform at the Grammys. He has been arrested in several U.S. states over altercations but was either not charged or prosecutors later dropped the charges. In 2019 he was arrested in Paris and questioned on suspicion of rape, but was released without charge. In return for his guilty plea, prosecutors dropped charges of assault, attempting to cause grievous bodily harm and having an offensive weapon, a bottle. Brown’s friend and vocal coach Omololu Akinlolu also pleaded guilty to affray and was given a four-month suspended sentence. Affray is the use or threat of unlawful violence that leads someone to fear for their safety. Brown has apologized for the attack Prosecutor Heidi Stonecliffe said Brown played a leading role in the attack. “By any circumstances, when one watches that footage, it is Mr. Brown that moves first,” Stonecliffe said. Defense lawyer Sallie Bennett-Jenkins said Brown apologized to all those at the club that night, though she emphasized the attack lasted no more than 20 seconds. “This is an ugly and unattractive incident,” Bennett-Jenkins said. “It is something which undoubtedly would have caused distress to those who are present and for which Mr. Brown … offers a profound apology to all those present.” Diaw was discharged from the hospital with head and knee injuries, Stonecliffe said. Crowds greet Brown outside court Brown was cheered outside the courthouse by fans who came from as far as Italy and the Netherlands. His face was covered behind in a black mask and dark glasses and his bleached hair was mostly hidden from view under a black ball cap. He wore a black leather jacket and light-colored turtleneck. He blew a kiss to one fan and appeared to sign an autograph for another as he moved through a pack of photographers and onlookers. Not everyone was cheering for him. When he arrived at court in the morning, a lone voice could be heard shouting at him to ask when he was going to learn that violence is not OK. Brown left the United Kingdom after the brawl but was arrested in May 2025 at a Manchester hotel after flying to the city for a concert. He had been free on bail of 5 million pounds ($6.7 million), which allowed him to tour Europe and North America the past two summers. Brown rose to stardom as a teen in 2005 and won his first Grammy for best R&B album in 2011 for “F.A.M.E.” He earned his second in the same category for “11:11 (Deluxe)” in 2025.

articles.title: Prince Harry making 'big mistake' that could destroy chance of royal reconciliation: expert
articles.summary: Prince Harry told GQ he wants peace with his family, but royal experts say his public interviews are thwarting any chance of reconciliation.
articles.body: Several royal experts believe Prince Harry is making a "big mistake" that could ruin his chances of reconciling with his family. In his first major interview since returning to the U.K. with his family, the Duke of Sussex told GQ he wants to make peace with his father and brother. However, royal commentator Richard Fitzwilliams told Fox News Digital that Harry's willingness to publicly discuss his strained family relationships only makes the royals more reluctant to extend an olive branch. "The peace offering is already undermined as it is public," said Fitzwilliams. "That continues to be his big mistake. He cannot be trusted. [The Sussexes] had already launched brutal attacks on the royal family [with their tell-alls]. Family disputes are bitter. But numerous interventions from 'friends' and interviews like Harry's in GQ make this highly unlikely." PRINCE HARRY SAYS ‘MOST IMPORTANT THING IS TO RECONCILE’ WITH ROYAL FAMILY Speaking about the family rift, Harry told GQ: "Some people don't want it to work out. I want it to work out. With everything else that's going on in the world, the most important thing is to reconcile — that's the key point." "Scars stick around forever," Harry continued. "But what your perception is, and what your mindset is to those things that have happened, letting go of the past. That’s something that I would encourage everybody to do: If there’s certain things from the past that are still affecting you every day, that’s harder to let go of. But, for me, there’s enough drama in the world and enough drama in people’s lives to continue with issues with family." articles.title: 'In Hindus, divorce doesn't exist,' says Govinda as he reveals why Sunita Ahuja took back her plea, says someone is influencing her: 'To steal your luck, they steal your woman'

articles.body: Govinda has spoken about the ongoing strain in his marriage to Sunita Ahuja, alleging that someone is influencing his wife and reacting to her decision to withdraw her divorce petition. Sunita had filed for divorce at the Bandra family court in Mumbai in December 2024 but reportedly withdrew the plea a couple of months ago. The actor has now shared his perspective on their relationship and the circumstances surrounding their marital differences.“She took back her divorce plea. She’d have to,” Govinda said in a recent interview. “We’re Hindus. The word ‘divorce’ doesn’t exist in our household,” he added. The actor also pointed out that although Sunita had been considering ending their marriage, she continued to live in one of his properties rather than formally moving out.“She can come back only if she ever left in the first place. I don’t believe anyone can leave me unless I want them to. Whichever house you want to play in, it belongs to me. You’re always lying around in my house.” He went on to suggest that others were influencing Sunita’s decisions, saying, “To steal your luck, they steal your woman," he said in an interview with ABP Live.The actor also spoke about how easily, in his view, a woman could be persuaded by others. “Just tell her, ‘How will this lead to your children’s welfare?’ and she’d buy into that,” he said. Govinda claimed that while he often turns to women for advice, he did not consider himself in a position to change Sunita’s perspective. “I just know whatever she’s doing, she’s doing for our children’s welfare,” he said.Govinda further suggested that attempting to persuade his wife to resolve their differences might not yield any results. Explaining his stance, he said, “I’m okay to be where I am right now because I feel if I budge, I’d cast a doubt on my own energy. I won’t do something to defame anyone. Why? Because I don’t see any progress there. It’s just a game, and I have to play along,” he said, smiling.Although he refrained from identifying the people he believes are influencing Sunita, Govinda maintained that others were involved. “No doubt there’ll be some people behind this. But I’ve never gone around looking,” he said. He then issued a warning to those he believes are behind the situation, adding, “I dare them to confront me. Do you think if they confront me, I won’t hurt them so badly that they won’t remember me for generations to come?”Sunita has reportedly accused Govinda of being involved with Komal Rani, his much younger co-star in his upcoming home production, 'Roopa'. The actor has denied having affairs with his former co-stars. Addressing the allegations, he said, “I’ve had four heroines like Miss Universe. But I haven’t engaged with them beyond greetings. Maybe I should’ve. It would’ve been nice. Then we’d have partied and had fun together.” He then added jokingly, “I regret it very much. If I get the chance today, I’d go for it.”However, Govinda also spoke about his personal life more seriously, claiming that he had not engaged in any extramarital affairs until at least the age of 37. Recalling a conversation with Sunita following his mother's death, he said she had expressed a desire to live life on her own terms after getting married at a young age.“My mom had passed then, and Sunita asked me, ‘I’ve never been able to live my life on my own terms. I got married into your house right out of school. I want to live life on my own terms now. I want freedom,'” Govinda recalled. He further claimed, “She stepped outside of marriage somewhere in that freedom. I told her, ‘When you’d come back, you won’t find me the way I am now.’ She said, ‘No problem.’ I didn’t have to ask anyone else in the whole world except her, and she said, ‘No problem,'” he added.Govinda, who married Sunita when he was 23 and she was 18, described her as his “first love”. Reflecting on their relationship, he said, “She didn’t get carried away. She wanted to live life the way she wants to. I or anybody else doesn’t have the right to ask her about that, unless she wants to share. She had lived the way I wanted to. She probably got fed up with it. articles.title: Eric Bauza, voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig, dies at 46
articles.summary: Eric Bauza, best known for voicing the lovable “Looney Tunes” characters Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig, has died, his family said Monday.
articles.body: Eric Bauza, best known for voicing the lovable “Looney Tunes” characters Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig, has died, his family said Monday. He was 46. Bauza’s family issued a brief statement on his official Instagram page stating that he had “passed away suddenly,” without giving further details. The Emmy Award-winning voice actor was the “modern voice of iconic “Looney Tunes” characters Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, along with dozens of other beloved cartoon characters,” the statement said. Bauza died Sunday at his residence, according to the Los Angeles County medical examiner’s office, which noted that he had been diagnosed with hypertensive cardiovascular disease. “Eric was a unique and versatile voice actor who was loved by everyone he knew and worked with,” his manager, Judy Coppage, told NBC News by email. “His sudden passing is a shock to all of us, and he will be deeply missed. It’s a profound loss for his family, the animation industry and his fans,” Coppage added. “The pleasure of watching him succeed and excel to become one of the most accomplished voices in animation was rewarding and thrilling.” The Canadian-American won three Emmy awards between 2022 and 2025 for his work, including voicing characters such as Elmer Fudd, Marvin the Martian and Tweety. He was also the first person of color to voice Bugs Bunny in the “Looney Tunes” cartoons, which he told NBC News in a 2021 interview led to a deluge of encouragement and adoration from the Asian American community. “Looney Tunes transcends all languages and all cultures,” he said at the time. “It doesn’t matter what part of the planet you’re from. You get the comedy.” Bauza said he grew up a massive ”Looney Tunes” fan, noting that the classic cartoons were part of the bond between his Filipino immigrant father and grandfather. He also said his obsessive attention to detail and persistence formed the foundation of his craft, as he grew up mimicking cartoon voices. Bauza also voiced some of the biggest animated characters in the 2021 movie “Space Jam: A New Legacy” and appeared in the 2023 “Super Mario Bros. Movie” and, most recently, the 2026 “Coyote vs. Acme” film. He also lent his voice to characters including Stimpy Cat in “Ren & Stimpy,” Foop from “The Fairly OddParents,” Fozzie Bear from “Muppet Babies” and the Beagle Boys from “DuckTales,” according to his IMDb page.

articles.body: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash’s 'Ramayana' is generating considerable interest ahead of its theatrical release, with advance bookings gaining momentum across several markets. Bookings opened on Dussehra, and with the film set to arrive in cinemas on November 5, more shows are gradually being added in regional languages to meet the demand.The film has reportedly collected around Rs 10 crore through advance bookings in India, with over two lakh tickets sold for its opening day. The Hindi version accounts for 87% of the total advance sales in the country and continues to lead the bookings. The Kannada version has also picked up pace, becoming available across around 100 screens and crossing Rs 1 crore in advance sales. Some theatres have reported occupancy of up to 80% for morning shows.The Telugu version, meanwhile, is witnessing a promising response despite its limited release so far. Available in only around 10–15 screens, it is heading towards Rs 40 lakh in advance bookings. The Hindi version has more than 4,200 shows listed for the opening day, while the Telugu and Kannada versions together have just over 400 shows.According to Sacnilk, four of the 44 Telugu shows currently open for bookings have already been marked houseful. On-ground tracking also indicates that the number of houseful shows across all languages could exceed a dozen once blocked seats are taken into account.'Ramayana' is also attracting audiences in North America, where paid previews are scheduled for November 4, a day before its Indian release. According to Sacnilk, advance ticket sales for the previews have reached $550,000, while the film has collected another $400,000 through advance bookings for its release day in overseas markets.With the domestic and overseas figures combined, the film's worldwide advance-booking collection crossed Rs 20 crore by the end of October 25, ten days ahead of its release.Meanwhile, the release schedule for the second instalment of Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana' may undergo a change. Highlighting the scale of the upcoming film, the insider added, “As everyone knows, the real scale of Ramayana is in the second part, where the war actually unfolds."Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, 'Ramayana' stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. articles.title: Christian singer Natalie Grant urges fans not to 'ignore your body' after fall led to emergency surgery
articles.summary: Natalie Grant reveals how a fall outside a restaurant led to kidney bleeding, an ICU stay and emergency surgery that could have ruptured her bladder.
articles.body: Christian singer Natalie Grant is opening up about a crazy health scare. During a recent interview with Fox News Digital, the 54-year-old singer discussed what it meant to her to honor Dolly Parton at the Dove Awards and how she ended up in the hospital with internal bleeding. Grant explained that after moving her daughter into her dorm room at college, they went out to dinner together with her husband, and on the way, her foot "caught this brick on the ground" and she "belly flopped" onto the ground. "I thought, 'Oh, maybe I broke a rib' or 'Man, that's gonna leave a bruise' or 'I kind of knocked the wind out of me,'" she said. "But then I got up and I kept walking to dinner. I'm like, I'm sore, but I'm gonna be okay. It wasn't until I realized that I was bleeding internally. And when I realized that it was an emergency, got to the emergency room. And they were like your bladder could rupture, because my kidney was bleeding, and I wasn't able to pass urine." She explained that when she initially arrived at the emergency room, doctors "were kind of confused about what was going on," and it wasn't until she was admitted into the ICU when they realized how serious her condition was. "I had a catheter so you could see the blood kept filling. I wouldn't stop bleeding, and I think that's when they were like we've got to get you in for surgery and figure out what's going on. But they all let me know like if you wouldn't have come in, like I talked about maybe going to a bigger hospital, and they said, 'No you were really smart to come as fast as you could and get here as quickly as you can,' because if I didn't, my bladder would have actually ruptured, and I wouldn't have known it." WATCH HERE: NATALIE GRANT SUFFERED INTERNAL BLEEDING AFTER SHE ‘BELLY FLOPPED’ ON HER WAY TO DINNER The singer went on to say that even through all her pain, she was thinking about her children and how they were feeling, noting that as moms, "we're always concerned about everybody around us," even when bleeding internally. While in the hospital, she was thinking of her daughter in the hospital with her, who "faints at the sight of blood," as well as her other two daughters back home in Nashville, and how she was going to tell them. I was like, 'No, we are celebrating the fact that she has finished college, and we are going to dinner together, and we're going to make this memory,'" she said. "And I'm kind of like hurting and limping and not able to fully eat my meal. And I was, like, I don't think I can ignore this anymore, but that was just such a picture of what moms do." After her incident, Grant urges her fans not to "ignore your body," saying, "God created our body in such a way that it gives us signs" and too often, those signs go ignored until "it's too late." WATCH HERE: CHRISTIAN SINGER NATALIE GRANT IS 100 PERCENT HEALED FROM HER INTERNAL INJURIES SUSTAINED AFTER A FALL Months after the fall, Grant said she has completely healed, and that, "funnily enough," she did actually break a rib in the fall, and that has been the most painful part. WATCH HERE: DOCTORS WERE INITIALLY CONFUSED WHEN NATALIE GRANT CAME INTO THE HOSPITAL AFTER HER FALL "I just last week had my final cystoscopy which checked inside my kidney and my bladder and everything looks fantastic. It's 100 percent healed. You actually can see a scar from where it was and there's I'm like, there's a sermon in that. It's all healed, we still have the scar, but it's healed. And then I just had an ultrasound as well. So internally, everything is 100%. And I just, I thank God because that could have gone 100 different directions. But I'm very, very grateful for good medical care and for the faithfulness of God took care of me." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? articles.title: In June 2026, Ariana Grande launched the Brighter Days Ahead Foundation; months later donates $125,000 to support transgender people, LGBTQ+ rights, mental health services and immigrant communities
articles.summary: Ariana Grande has spent years quietly backing the causes that she cares about. This year she decided to make that support stronger and more effective.
articles.body: Ariana Grande has spent years quietly backing the causes that she cares about. This year she decided to make that support stronger and more effective. In June 2026, she launched The Brighter Days Ahead Foundation, a new charity designed to put money and attention where it is needed most. The foundation recently directed $125,000 toward groups helping LGBTQ+ people, mental-health services, and immigrant communities, showing that her approach is about more than a single check. Ariana Grande has built her reputation in celebrity philanthropy through her initiative.Ariana Grande’s four clear paths for givingThe foundation works through four separate funds. Protect & Defend, Heal & Dream, Seen & Celebrated, and Emergency work together on the ground to support organisations fighting for LGBTQ+ rights, civil rights, and reproductive justice. It also focuses on mental-health care and community support. The foundation additionally assists in places where crises hit and quick help is required.These streams allow the foundation to support a wide range of groups without spreading itself too thin. According to Pink News, while speaking about the foundation, Grande said, “Our mission is to support, protect, and provide resources for our vulnerable friends in need.” “It has been my privilege to be able to support these causes on my own over the years,” she added. “I’m grateful to now be able to expand that reach and amplify the life-saving work that these organisations do.” The structure also builds on Grande’s earlier work, including a 2022 campaign that raised more than $3 million for transgender young people.Ariana Grande’s $125,000 that reached trans lifelineOne of the first major gifts went to Trans Lifeline, a nonprofit that runs a crisis hotline for transgender people. The organisation received a total of $125,000 from Grande, combining emergency funding with a grant announced at the foundation’s launch.According to Trans Lifeline executive director Dante Alviar Horton, who revealed this in an interview with the Chronicle of Philanthropy, the money restarted a microgrants programme. That programme put $100,000 directly into the hands of transgender people through five grassroots partners. Some of the funds also covered benefits for the organisation’s crisis-service workers. In practical terms, the donation kept a vital service running and helped people who often struggle to find immediate financial support.Ariana Grande’s support changed livesGrande’s philanthropic adviser, Shauna Nep, has said the foundation was created at a time when support for some of these causes was declining. “We’re seeing the support for the kinds of issues she cares about going down drastically and the attacks going up aggressively,” Nep said. Larger institutional funders can overlook smaller organisations that work closest to the people in need. Celebrity foundations can help fill that gap by providing flexible money and public attention.The model is not new. Elton John’s AIDS Foundation, started in 1992, showed how a famous name can bring resources and reduce stigma. The difference today is that social media lets artists speak directly to fans and donors. That reach is powerful, but it also requires consistency. A one-time viral moment is less useful than steady funding that lets organisations plan .Looking beyond the spotlightBrighter Days Ahead gives Grande a formal way to continue the causes she has supported for years. Its success will depend on more than her name. It will depend on whether other donors follow the lead, how regularly the funds are distributed, and whether the partner organisations can turn the money into lasting services.For the groups receiving help, the real test is what happens after the headlines fade. A hotline that stays open, a microgrant that pays a rent bill, or a legal clinic that keeps fighting are the measures that matter. Grande’s foundation is an attempt to turn fame into a reliable bridge between public attention and practical help. If it continues on that path, the brighter days it promises may reach further than any single donation ever could.Ariana Grande, the pop star she isAriana Grande is a global pop star and actress known for her powerful voice and chart-topping hits. She rose to fame through Nickelodeon and later dominated music with albums that mixed vulnerability and big production. In recent years,she has balanced music with major film roles, including the highly successful Wicked movies. articles.summary: Ella Langley's "Loving Life Again" hit No. 1 on Billboard's Country Airplay chart, making her the fastest female artist to reach six No. 1s.
articles.body: Ella Langley's impressive run continues to roll on. As our loyal readers know, Ella Langley has absolutely captivated the country music world over the past couple years. There's no question she's currently sitting at the top of the mountain. The "Choosin' Texas" singer had a monster 2025, and then kicked things into a new gear in 2026 with songs that are dominating the charts and racking up awards. COUNTRY SUPERSTAR ELLA LANGLEY PULLS OFF INCREDIBLE CAREER ACCOMPLISHMENT ON THE MUSIC CHARTS Now, she can add another achievement to her growing list. Ella Langley pulls off another impressive career accomplishment. Langley has had several songs blow up in 2026 following the release of her latest album, "Dandelion." 'CHOOSIN' TEXAS' TURNS ONE AS ELLA LANGLEY REFLECTS ON THE SONG THAT MADE HER COUNTRY'S BIGGEST STAR Billboard reported a few days ago that Luminate data shows that "Loving Life Again" hit the number one spot on Billboard's Country airplay chart. It's her sixth song to hold the spot, and she is the fastest female artist to achieve the accomplishment of six number ones on the chart in the 36-year-history of it existing, according to the same report. 'GOD HAS BEEN SO GOOD TO ME': ELLA LANGLEY REACTS TO INCREDIBLE NINE CMA AWARDS NOMINATIONS It is also her fourth song from "Dandelion" to hit the number one spot on the chart. It's only the third album from a female artist in history to have four songs peak in the number one spot, according to Billboard. articles.body: Kriti Sanon has left movie lovers excited by sharing a video with her ‘Bhediya’ co-star Varun Dhawan and director Amar Kaushik. The clip has set off talk that the trio may soon announce ‘Bhediya 2’.The video that started the buzzKriti Sanon posted the short clip on her Instagram Stories on Monday. It shows Kriti, Varun and Amar smiling at the camera and making a howl, a nod to their film ‘Bhediya’. The text on the video read, “An unexpected reunion that will get you “Obsessed”! Stay Tuned!!” Varun also reshared the post on his own account.Nothing has been confirmed yet. Still, fans believe the three could be getting ready to announce ‘Bhediya 2’.A third film together?Besides ‘Bhediya’, Kriti and Varun have worked together in ‘Dilwale’. If ‘Bhediya 2’ goes ahead, it will be their third film as a pair.Their recent get-togetherThe two were also seen together in May at an evening of music and fun with friends. Kriti’s sister Nupur Sanon, her singer husband Stebin Ben and ‘Fukrey’ actor Varun Sharma joined them. The group danced to ‘Tera Ho Jaun’ from Varun’s film ‘Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai’. The romantic song is sung by Stebin and Jonita Gandhi, and its lyrics are by Vayu.The post was captioned, “Tera Ho Jaun .. .. .. with the madness...Don’t miss the end.”About ‘Bhediya’The horror-comedy follows Bhaskar, a road-construction contractor played by Varun, who is bitten by a wolf in the forests of Arunachal Pradesh. He soon starts turning into a werewolf. Kriti plays Anika, a veterinarian who knows more about the strange events than she first reveals. ‘Bhediya’ released in theatres in November 2022.Work frontOn the work front, Varun Dhawan was last seen in 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' co-starring Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur.
